title: Global Sobolev Convergence of Howard Iteration for Finite-Horizon Controlled Diffusions
summary: We study Howard policy iteration for finite-horizon stochastic control problems in which the control enters the diffusion coefficient. Each iteration selects a policy by maximizing the Hamiltonian and evaluates it through a linear parabolic equation. Since the improvement depends on the Hessian, even smooth data can produce discontinuous evaluation coefficients. We prove global convergence in the full parabolic Sobolev space under assumptions that allow this loss of regularity.
